title: And from her arms
html_source: Presumably also a reference to the arms of Anne Hathaway, a resident of Shottery and Shakespeare’s wife. She married Shakespeare in Nov. 1582 and gave birth to their daughter Susanna in May 1583. Therefore, it is possible Hathaway and Shakespeare did spend time in slumberous fields at midnight in the summer of 1582.
